GeneralSettings.DebugInfo: Turns debug mode on to print extra logs to the script.log file
GeneralSettings.FishQualityInfo: Sets the base value for the fish quantity bar

PredatorSettings.PredatorSpawnEnabledInfo: Turns on(1) and off(0) the predators feature of the mod. When on, it will enable the random spawning of predators when catching/cutting up the fish.
PredatorSettings.PredatorSpawnChanceInfo: Controls the chance for a predator to spawn when a fish is caught or cut up. Fishing is when fishing, preparing is when getting fillets, failcatch is when nothing is caught.
PredatorSettings.PredatorSpawnSoundInfo: PredatorWarningSoundEnable controls the audible notification and PredatorWarningSoundRadius controls how far players hear the sound from the triggering player.
PredatorSettings.PredatorWarningMessageInfo: PredatorWarningMessageEnable turns the chat message on and off, PredatorWarningMessage'Color' controls the color of the text. Only set one of the colors to on at a time.

CFToolsLogging.LoggingInfo: Requires the ExtraLogs mod by TRG to use this section.
